curatedMovie.curiosityHook: When a reunion fraught with shared romantic history is fractured by sudden bloodshed, where do tangled loyalties fall?
curatedMovie.description: After 15 years apart, flamboyant actress Becky returns to her daughter Rebeca's life for a concert, only to discover Rebeca is married to Becky's ex-lover. As they reconnect, an unexpected murder upends everything.
curatedMovie.vibeSummary: Stylized, suspenseful comedy-drama with steady pacing, emotional flair, and an engaged date-night appeal.
curatedMovie.whyWatch: Pedro Almodóvar spins family melodrama into a lively crime comedy where glamorous theatrics meet genuine domestic tension.
